title: Value of the Vehicle as an Evidence Ground on a Fault Report
content:
What the marketplace has most recently valued a Keyturn Vehicle Listing at is an evidence ground of its own, the figure read being the amount carried by the most recently recorded marketplace valuation standing on the vehicle's condition record.

- A vehicle whose most recently recorded marketplace valuation is 60000 USD or more adds 3 photographs.
- A vehicle whose most recently recorded valuation is 30000 USD or more but below 60000 USD adds 1 photograph.
- A vehicle whose most recently recorded valuation is below 30000 USD adds nothing on this ground, an addition of 0 photographs.

### Points of judgement

*Which valuation is read.* The most recently recorded one, by the date it was recorded. A higher valuation recorded earlier does not displace a lower one recorded later.

*At 60000 USD exactly.* The vehicle is on the first clause and adds 3 photographs; at 59999.99 USD it is on the second and adds 1.

*At 30000 USD exactly.* The vehicle is on the second clause and adds 1 photograph; at 29999.99 USD it is on the third and adds nothing on this ground.
